title: Standard v9 forensic repair — data quality (Phase 1)
rule: no model research starts until this file exists with status PASS and a CURRENT fingerprint

identity.post_fix_canonical_proof: benchmark frame = v9 loader at v9_commit (includes v9's 6c80672f club canonicaliser) + Pro evidence-based alias map + quarantine; exact duplicates and same-day club collisions in the benchmark are both 0

source_predictability.handling: history-window ablations must compare MODERN_ONLY (football-data, 2023/24+) against MODERN+ARCHIVE explicitly; never pool the archive in silently

STANDARD_LIVE_SETTLEMENT_AND_ENTRY_PRICE.meaning: a live Standard tip's settlement and the price it was tipped at

fixes.what: Resolve OddsAPI club names against football-data history (46% of standard fixtures had no form)
OddsAPI Ligue 2 sport key (Ligue 2 had never been fetchable)

STANDARD_SERVED_MODEL_INPUTS.meaning: the served probability was computed by a model trained on a frame with the live season, the four recovered seasons of corners/HT/O-U price and v9's club canonicaliser

fixes.what: Resolve OddsAPI club names against football-data history (46% of standard fixtures had no form)
Write NaN instead of invented values when enrichment does not run (29 stand-in columns)
data_loader season list derived (was a year stale: live season never downloaded)
Four seasons of corners / half-time goals / O-U price frozen out of training

open_defects: residual alias collisions in v9's frame (identity.py) - not fixed in v9
batch-median imputation, home_advantage constant live, away-HT scope, cross-league rolling order (R1 / identity.rolling_order_leak) - not fixed in v9

STANDARD_SIDE_MARKET_REAL_PRICE_ENTRY.meaning: a BTTS/O1.5 quote captured forward is a full-match price (1H filter applied on read)

fixes.what: BTTS capture parser stored the FIRST-HALF market as full-match
Filter first-half BTTS out of both model read paths

STANDARD_FORWARD_CLOSE_T30.meaning: a certified T-30m close exists (capture ran inside the window)

fixes.what: BTTS capture parser stored the FIRST-HALF market as full-match
A closing price counts only within 30 min of kickoff

STANDARD_HISTORICAL_SIDE_MARKET_ROI.meaning: historical BTTS/O1.5/O3.5 ROI: no real two-sided timed price exists historically; constant fills (1.85/1.40/2.60) are never certifiable

fixes.what: Backtest: a filled price is not a price (O1.5 certified on a constant 1.40)

LIGUE2_API_FOOTBALL_DERIVED.meaning: Ligue 2 data fetched by API-Football league id (player history, injuries, AF quotes)
